title: 第482章 陪我去看流星雨
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“妈妈快看，是流星！”

“傻孩子，哪有什么流星？快点睡觉。”

“哦～好吧。”

火护山周遭的村庄内，

很多晚睡的村民都看到了几十年难得一遇的流星雨。

不少人纷纷走出家门，向着天空许愿祈祷。

…...

“陪我去看流星雨，它落在大地上，让你的血落在我肩膀～”

山头之上，

林奇一边疯狂吸收源晶，一边疯狂地推动陨火流星雨。

那苍白脸色上又带着一丝病态的笑容，让一旁的杰克只感觉脊背发凉。

他很想问一句，为什么血会落在肩膀上？

“嘎！”

夜空之上，

一只岚鸟不幸被火流星砸中，身躯直接被轰碎，血肉内脏漫天纷飞。

半截残肢从半空坠落，落在二人身侧。

杰克抬手拂去头上沾染的鸟毛，

又抹了一把脸上温热的血迹，这才明白，血为什么会落在肩膀上了。

“团长，你要不要休息一会？”

这场流星雨已经持续了十分钟了，如此大范围的魔法攻击，对御卡师的消耗极大。

林奇一甩头上的鸟毛，眼底翻滚着兴奋。

“没事，我不累。”

杰克看了眼下方崩溃的兽潮，又出声劝道。

“你再这么打下去，卡兽就跑光了。”

闻言，林奇这才看向下方的战场。

陨火流星雨不分敌我，

在这般巨大的打击之下，山寨的墙壁和建筑全都倒塌一片，满地尸骸焦土。

大量山贼在天火之中死伤惨重、哀嚎遍野。

而原本汹涌奔腾的兽潮，更是彻底乱了阵脚。

如此恐怖的天灾之下，

卡兽已经彻底挣脱领主号令，不要命的冲进林奇布置的陷阱火墙。

哪怕被烧的皮毛炸裂，也要离开这个恐怖的地方。

“这群卡兽真是弱不禁风，这么美丽的流星雨，给它们机会看也不珍惜啊。”

林奇摇摇头，掏出一张卡牌递给杰克。

卡牌上的图案是一张屏障，正是上次从贵族手里缴获的结界卡。

“杰克，等会你潜进去，用这张结界卡把那红头发的变态给拦下来，不要让他跑了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Mom, look, it's a shooting star!"

"Silly boy, where are the shooting stars? Go to bed quickly."

"Oh~ okay."

In the villages around Huohu Mountain,

Many villagers who stayed up late saw a rare meteor shower in decades.

Many people walked out of their homes and made wishes and prayers to the sky.

…

"Come with me to watch the meteor shower. When it falls on the earth, let your blood fall on my shoulders~"

On top of the mountain,

Lin Qi was frantically absorbing the source crystal while frantically pushing the meteor shower.

There was a sickly smile on that pale face, which made Jack beside him feel a chill down his spine.

He wanted to ask, why did the blood fall on his shoulder?

"Gah!"

above the night sky,

Unfortunately, a mischievous bird was hit by a bolide. Its body was directly smashed into pieces, and its flesh and blood and internal organs were scattered all over the sky.

Half of the stumps fell from the air and landed beside the two of them.

Jack raised his hand to brush away the bird feathers on his head.

After wiping the warm blood on his face again, he realized why the blood fell on his shoulders.

"Captain, do you want to take a rest?"

This meteor shower has been going on for ten minutes. Such a large-scale magic attack consumes a lot of money on the card master.

Lin Qi flicked the bird feathers on his head, his eyes rolling with excitement.

"It's okay, I'm not tired."

Jack glanced at the crumbling beasts below, and then spoke out to persuade them.

"If you keep fighting like this, all the card beasts will run away."

Hearing this, Lin Qi looked at the battlefield below.

The meteor shower does not distinguish between friend and foe,

Under such a huge blow, all the walls and buildings of the village collapsed, and the ground was covered with corpses and scorched earth.

A large number of bandits suffered heavy casualties in the sky fire, and howled across the land.

The originally surging tide of beasts was completely in disarray.

Under such a horrific natural disaster,

The card beast has completely broken away from the lord's command and rushed into the fire wall of the trap set by Lynch desperately.

Even if his burned fur bursts, he must leave this terrifying place.

"These card beasts are really weak. They don't cherish the opportunity to see such a beautiful meteor shower."

Lynch shook his head, took out a card and handed it to Jack.

The pattern on the card is a barrier, which is exactly the barrier card captured from the nobles last time.

"Jack, sneak in later and use this barrier card to stop the red-haired pervert. Don't let him escape."
